editorial:
Imagine being trapped in your own school while the world outside turns into a nightmare. You follow Sloane and four of her classmates who hide inside Cortege High to stay safe from a scary outbreak of infected people. The vibe is super tense from the start because you feel the danger just inches away from the doors. It starts as a story about survival, but it quickly turns into a battle of wills. You get to see Sloane change from a scared student into a leader who is willing to do whatever it takes to make sure they actually survive the night.

The acting feels real and the pacing keeps you on the edge of your seat without slowing down too much. While some of the scares are predictable, the twists in the second half really pack a punch. If you love stories where regular people have to get tough fast, you will love this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that one of the students was actually infected and letting the monsters in. Sloane has to make a hard choice to sacrifice her friend to save the others. She manages to lock the main gates and lead the remaining survivors to the roof. The movie ends with a rescue helicopter arriving, but as the camera zooms out, you see thousands of infected surrounding the school, leaving you wondering if they are truly safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie movies and survival stories.
